Overview

Dnipro is a city in Dnipropetrovsk with a population of 980,000. A major industrial and space industry city on the Dnieper River, a key center for Ukraine’s rocket and missile industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
